provider.name: Databento
provider.note: No API credentials available. Exact metadata commands emitted.

future_capability.note: MBO available from 2017-05-21. NOT used in primary pilot.

6E.name: Euro FX
6E.quotation_direction_note: A price increase means EUR strengthens vs USD.
6E.expiration_rule: last business day before the 3rd Wednesday of the contract month

6J.name: Japanese Yen FX
6J.quotation_direction_note: A PRICE INCREASE means JPY STRENGTHENS vs USD. This is the inverse of the common spot USDJPY convention.
6J.expiration_rule: last business day before the 3rd Wednesday of the contract month

6B.name: British Pound FX
6B.quotation_direction_note: A price increase means GBP strengthens vs USD.
6B.expiration_rule: last business day before the 3rd Wednesday of the contract month

contracts.source_provenance: CME Group product specifications (authoritative). Verify against Databento Definition schema records (min_tick_size, md_price_multiplier, start_date, end_date) when data is acquired.

eligibility.description: A contract is eligible on date D iff: (1) it is an outright standard 6E/6J/6B future; (2) Definition metadata shows it active on D; (3) D precedes its frozen calendar roll date; (4) valid definition and book data exist on D. NO selection based on realized volume, OI, returns, or profitability.

roll_rule.description: Roll exactly 5 CME trading days before expiration. The next eligible quarterly contract becomes the new front. Uses calendar/expiration metadata only. Do NOT use realized volume, OI, returns, or profitability.

eligibility.no_back_adjustment: Individual raw contracts remain the scientific source. No back-adjusted synthetic prices.
eligibility.supersedes: V1 rule incorrectly required one quarterly contract to span the entire pilot. Replaced with per-date eligibility.

schema.immutable_source_truth: Raw DBN/DBN.ZST files are the immutable source of truth.

core_fields.ts_recv: int64, nanoseconds since Unix epoch, Databento receive time (UTC)
core_fields.ts_event: int64, nanoseconds since Unix epoch, exchange event time (UTC)
core_fields.action: char enum: A=Add, M=Modify, D=Delete, T=Trade/Execute, C=Clear
core_fields.depth: u8, price level depth 1-10 (1 = best/top) for the triggering event
core_fields.price: int64, price in raw units, 1 unit = 1e-9 (i.e. price/1e9 = actual price)
core_fields.size: int64, size in raw units for the triggering event
core_fields.flags: u8, bitwise OR of record flags
core_fields.ts_in_delta: int32, nanosecond delta from previous event (input)

top10_level_arrays.description: Each MBP-10 record embeds the resulting top-10 market-by-price state.
top10_level_arrays.bid_px_00_to_09: int64[10], bid prices at levels 0-9 (0 = best bid)
top10_level_arrays.ask_px_00_to_09: int64[10], ask prices at levels 0-9 (0 = best ask)
top10_level_arrays.bid_ct_00_to_09: int64[10], bid order counts at levels 0-9 (if present)
top10_level_arrays.ask_ct_00_to_09: int64[10], ask order counts at levels 0-9 (if present)

removed_from_v1.seq_msg: REMOVED - not in Databento documented MBP-10 schema
removed_from_v1.msg_type: REMOVED - not in Databento documented MBP-10 schema
removed_from_v1.channel: REMOVED - not in Databento documented MBP-10 schema
removed_from_v1.ts_out_delta: REMOVED - not in Databento documented MBP-10 schema

canonical_provenance.raw_dbn_hash: SHA-256 of the source DBN.ZST file

trade_side.no_inference: Do NOT infer UNKNOWN trades from trade_price vs previous mid in the primary pilot. UNKNOWN remains a valid value. No forced signing.
trade_side.supersedes: V1 defined a deterministic classifier (price vs mid_prev). REMOVED. Provider-native B/A/N is the frozen semantics.

book_state.principle: MBP-10 is NOT an MBO delta stream. The provider-supplied top-10 level state on each MBP-10 record is AUTHORITATIVE. action/depth describe the triggering event; the embedded bid/ask level arrays describe the resulting market-by-price state.
book_state.no_manual_mutation: Do NOT manually mutate the book using invented ADD/MODIFY/DELETE/EXECUTE arithmetic unless verified byte-for-byte against Databento's documented representation.
validity_criteria: valid BBO where market is open (bid_px_00 > 0 AND ask_px_00 > 0)
bid < ask except documented non-trading states
monotone price levels (bid_px_00 >= bid_px_01 >= ... >= bid_px_09; ask_px_00 <= ask_px_01 <= ... <= ask_px_09)
explicit missing level representation (size=0 or price=0 for empty levels)
book_state.no_full_10_requirement: A book can be valid with fewer than 10 populated levels on either side. Do NOT require all 10 levels on both sides for validity.
book_state.no_silent_repair: Never silently repair. All anomalies explicitly marked.
book_state.supersedes: V1 defined ADD/MODIFY/DELETE/EXECUTE/CLEAR mutation rules. REPLACED with authoritative embedded state semantics.

admitted: MBP order-flow imbalance (OFI from level changes)
information_classes.never_reconstruct: Never reconstruct fake L3 from MBP-10.

timestamps.ts_event_semantics: Exchange event time, int64 ns since Unix epoch (UTC).
timestamps.ts_recv_semantics: Databento receive time, int64 ns since Unix epoch (UTC).

mdp2_limitations.pre_2017_05_21: ts_recv = ts_event, F_BAD_TS_RECV expected. NOT genuine capture latency.

timestamps.no_latency_alpha: Do NOT derive latency alpha from unsupported timestamps.

mdp3_mbofd.max_granularity: MBO (order-by-order) available, but primary V4 pilot remains MBP-10
mdp3_mbofd.ts_recv_behavior: Genuine receive time (may differ from ts_event)

protocol_regimes.protocol_era_field: Provenance must include a protocol_era field (mdp2_fix_flat or mdp3_mbofd) for each record/partition.
protocol_regimes.not_an_alpha_feature: protocol_era is a provenance/metadata field. Do NOT use it as an alpha feature.

execution.reason: Uniform historical MBP-10 does not establish individual queue position.

insufficient_size.description: If displayed top-level size is insufficient, reject that event as non-executable. No depth walking in primary pilot.

execution.single_contract_preference: Prefer 1 contract for initial falsification pilot.

observed_market_data.spread: ask_px_00 - bid_px_00 (charged separately, NOT part of explicit cost)
observed_market_data.depth_consumption: size consumed at the executable level

explicit_transaction_costs.cme_exchange_fee: Per CME fee schedule (varies by contract, customer type, volume tier). Use authoritative fee documentation.
explicit_transaction_costs.nfa_regulatory_fee: NFA fee per contract per side.
explicit_transaction_costs.broker_clearing: Broker markup + clearing fee per contract per side.

frozen_assumption.description: Conservative constant: $2.50 per contract per side, covering CME exchange + NFA + broker/clearing. Frozen BEFORE outcomes. Documented as ASSUMPTION.
frozen_assumption.label: ASSUMPTION
frozen_assumption.rationale: CME FX futures exchange fees are typically $0.50-$2.50 per contract per side depending on customer type and volume tier. NFA fee is ~$0.03-$0.15. Broker markup varies. $2.50/side is a conservative upper bound for a retail/institutional hybrid.

costs.no_bps: Explicit futures fees are NOT expressed as percentage bps of notional. The V1 1.0-bps-per-side assumption is REMOVED.
costs.no_double_counting_spread: Spread is observed market data, charged separately. Explicit costs are USD/contract/side. No double counting.
costs.no_post_hoc_optimization: Do NOT optimize fees after outcomes.

axes.PRICE_PATH_EXPOSURE: Whether price paths were previously observed in V1-V3.
axes.MICROSTRUCTURE_EXPOSURE: Whether MBP-10 microstructure was previously observed.

exposure_registry.legacy_holdout: Completely sealed. NOT accessible in V4.

chronology.principle: Completely pre-2018 chronology. 2018-01-01 onward = SEALED. No V4 development/validation/holdout period touches 2018+. No backward validation.

development.protocol_era: MDP2 (pre-2017-05-21), ms precision pre-2015-11-20, ns precision 2015-11-20 to 2017-05-21

chronology.supersedes: V1 had external_validation 2017-07 to 2018-03 and holdout 2018-04 to 2018-12. BOTH REMOVED (touched 2018+). Replaced with completely pre-2018 chronology.

targets.principle: Small target family frozen prospectively. No strategy parameters. No horizon optimization.

primary_target.description: Future midprice (or microprice) change from feature cutoff to t+H. Or tick-normalized future mid move. NOT strategy-direction-dependent.
primary_target.formula: target = (mid_{t+H} - mid_t) / mid_t  or  target = (mid_{t+H} - mid_t) / tick_size
primary_target.mid_definition: mid = (bid_px_00 + ask_px_00) / 2  or microprice = (bid_px_00*ask_sz_00 + ask_px_00*bid_sz_00) / (bid_sz_00 + ask_sz_00)

economic_evaluation.buy_round_trip: BUY: enter at ask_px_00, exit at bid_px_00 (or vice versa) + explicit USD/contract fees
economic_evaluation.sell_round_trip: SELL: enter at bid_px_00, exit at ask_px_00 (or vice versa) + explicit USD/contract fees

constraints: target begins strictly after feature cutoff
no leakage (feature window and target window do not overlap)
targets.supersedes: V1 target was signed price change (direction-dependent). REPLACED with direction-neutral mid/microprice change.

pilot.objective: DOES MBP-10 ADD INCREMENTAL INFORMATION BEYOND PRICE HISTORY?
pilot.secondary_metric: Is the incremental information economically large enough relative to executable spread + explicit USD/contract fees?
hypotheses: H1: Signed trade flow (B/A side) predicts short-horizon mid change beyond price history.
H2: Top-of-book imbalance (bid_sz_00/ask_sz_00) predicts short-horizon mid change beyond price history.
H3: Multi-level depth imbalance (levels 0-9) adds information beyond top-of-book alone.
H4: Event-time sampling captures more predictive information than fixed M1 clock-time sampling.
H5: Microstructure state identifies periods where expected mid move >> executable spread + explicit USD/contract fees.
pilot.fail_fast: If no hypothesis shows incremental information on dev+val, STOP.
